name: LEMS-A3
full_name: Lunar Environment Monitoring Station for Artemis III
note: A3 flight numbers only from printed public sources. TRL-6 / DALI predecessor mass 34–35 kg and 1200 Wh store are not this box. Geometry A/L and A_rad not printed — this line runs a declared bracket, no middle value.

mass_kg.close_with: Printed A3 flight mass (kg) from PI/NASA/ICES. Do not borrow 34 kg ETU (Benna CLPS 2022) or 35 kg DALI (TFAWS 2020).

store_Wh.cite: ICES 2025 NTRS 20250005257: allocated battery energy 640 Wh for a 354 hr period between sun illuminations (requirement + Fig. 14 thermal energy balance).

battery_nameplate_Wh.close_with: Printed A3 nameplate / usable Wh (640 is allocation for temperature maintenance, not nameplate).

battery_chemistry.close_with: Printed A3 cell chemistry. TRL-6 Ibeos Li-ion 8S8P is predecessor, not A3.

P_keepalive_W.cite: ICES 2025 Fig. 14: Internal Electronics CBE Heat 1.231 W (cold operational steady state).

P_leak_analyzed_W.cite: ICES 2025 Fig. 14 / conclusion: nighttime heat leak 1.528 W for 354 hr (CDR analysis, not this Fourier).

E_thermal_analyzed_Wh.cite: ICES 2025 Fig. 14 / §V: 1.528 W for 354 hr or 541 Wh.

P_peak_monthly_comms_W.cite: ICES 2025 §III: monthly three-hour communication transient MEV heat dissipation 37.99 W.

P_daily_download_W.cite: ICES 2025 §III: daily data downloads expected to spike as high as 5.92 W.

H_night_h.cite: ICES 2025: 354 hr period between sun illuminations (Fig. 14 thermal energy balance).

T_box_C.cite: ICES 2025 §II: bus heater nominally set to -28/-26°C. Night hold uses the printed −28 °C deadband.

T_box_K.cite: derived from printed −28 °C (ICES §II). Not printed as kelvin.

T_env_C.cite: ICES 2025 §II.C: 'The SAPP harnessing in the cold operational steady state case bridges the internal thermal zone at -30°C to the external thermal zones at approximately -200°C'. Path-specific SAPP zone, not a whole-box night sink. Used as the warm T_env bound only.

T_env_K.cite: OPEN — no printed whole-box night sink for LEMS-A3. Two printed bounds, no middle. Cold printed number is 'below 23K', not a floor at 38 K.
T_env_K.close_with: Printed A3 night environment temperature of the bus as a single value. ICES ≈−200 °C is SAPP external zone in the cold operational case, not a box sink. Paige 'below 23K' is a PSR excursion (OPEN_below_printed), colder than a sunlit-rim landing site.
T_env_K.page_or_figure: ICES §II.C SAPP zone; Paige 2011 LPI 6058 p.1

bracket_lo.cite: Paige et al. 2011 LPI 6058 p.1: 'surface temperature excursions below 23K are briefly observed'. 23 K is the coldest printed number, not a floor — the paper says below. OPEN_below_printed. PSR/polar floor, colder than a sunlit-rim landing site — not this box's sink. Annual average 'less than 38K' is not the cold bound.
bracket_lo.quote: surface temperature excursions below 23K are briefly observed
bracket_lo.quote_annual: The results show that the coldest regions on the Moon achieve annual average temperatures of less than 38K

bracket_hi.label: SAPP external zone, cold operational case — used as warm reference bound, not a box sink
bracket_hi.cite: derived from printed ≈ −200 °C (ICES §II.C) for SAPP harnessing external thermal zones. Not printed as kelvin. Not a whole-box night sink.

latitude_analysis_deg.cite: ICES 2025 Table 1 environment cases: Latitude 90 and 83.5. Exact A3 landing site OPEN.

landing_site_name.close_with: Named A3 landing site after NASA selection. Printed region is lunar South Pole / South Polar region (LPSC 2025 2410; NASA Science).

lifetime_years.cite: LPSC 2025 2410: three-month threshold mission and two-year baseline. ICES: 24 lunations. NASA Science: three months up to two years. GSFC: two years longevity goal.

lifetime_threshold_months.cite: LPSC 2025 2410: three-month threshold mission. NASA Science: from three months up to two years.

lifetime_lunations.cite: ICES 2025 abstract/§I: design life of 24 lunations (approx. two Earth years).

hibernation_pct.cite: ICES 2025 §I: Hibernation Mode 98.6% of the mission.

hibernation_frac.cite: derived from printed 98.6% (ICES §I). Not printed as a fraction.

imli_layers.cite: ICES 2025 §II.B: 18-layer IMLI, double aluminized Kapton, outer Nextel/Stamet.

eps_eff.close_with: Printed A3 e* as a single value. Paper gives upper bound < 0.0028 from TRL-6 IMLI measurement; no A3 lower bound. Court brackets 0 to 0.0028.

eps_eff_upper.cite: ICES 2025 §II.B: effective emissivity less than 0.0028 as measured during the TRL-6 (IMLI used on A3).

A_path_m2.close_with: Printed strut/rod cross-section A. Heat-switch open G < 0.002 W/K is printed; A and L are not.

L_path_m.close_with: Printed conductive length of heat-switch rod / ULTEM standoffs / SAPP stretch.

A_rad_m2.close_with: Printed IMLI or radiator area (m²). Suitcase-size is qualitative (NASA Science). Not LuSEE 0.15.

enclosure_dimensions_m.close_with: Printed bus L×W×H. NASA Science says suitcase-size only.

G_heat_switch_open_W_per_K.cite: ICES 2025 §II.D: heat switch open path through ULTEM housing to INVAR 36 rod has conductance below 0.002 W/°C.

G_heat_switch_closed_W_per_K.cite: ICES 2025 §II.D: above 0°C, aluminum plates pressed together, heat flows at approximately 5 W/°C (day path, not night).

strut_alloy_launch_lock_night.cite: ICES 2025 §II.A: four ULTEM 1000 standoffs are the deployed conductive path. No NIST metal map — T0 hole.

titanium_legs_alloy.close_with: Printed titanium alloy (e.g. Ti-6Al-4V). Paper says titanium only. Do not assume Ti-6Al-4V.

sapp_mli_layers.cite: ICES 2025 §II.C: SAPP harnessing inside IMLI wrapped with 6-layer MLI.

night_strategy.value: battery + Kapton foil heaters + electronics waste heat; heat switch open at night; IMLI; no RHU stated for A3
night_strategy.cite: ICES 2025 §II: four software-controlled Kapton foil heaters; Fig. 14 electronics 1.231 W + heater 0.297 W against 640 Wh allocation. RHU is not stated in the A3 paper (DALI 2020 0–2 RHU is predecessor).

rhu.close_with: Printed A3 RHU count. A3 ICES does not name an RHU. Do not copy TFAWS 2020 0–2 RHU.

P_path_heat_switch_W.cite: ICES 2025 Fig. 14: Heat Switch -0.474 W (their Thermal Desktop, not Fourier A/L).

P_path_sapp_W.cite: ICES 2025 Fig. 14: Signal and Power Passthrough -0.398 W.

geometry_bracket.honesty: DECLARED_BRACKET. Geometry A/L and A_rad are OPEN. No middle value.

G_path_W_per_K.lo_cite: ICES 2025 §II.D heat-switch open < 0.002 W/K (one printed conduction path).
G_path_W_per_K.hi_cite: DECLARED_BRACKET: three night conduction paths (heat switch + ULTEM launch lock + SAPP). hi = 3× the printed heat-switch open bound. Launch-lock and SAPP A/L not printed.

eps_eff.lo_cite: OPEN lower bound — A3 paper does not print a floor on e*.

A_rad_m2.cite: DECLARED_BRACKET: IMLI/radiator area not printed. Not dust_camera 0.02, not another mission's radiator.

L_path_m.cite: DECLARED_UNIT so A_path = G/k. P_cond = G·ΔT is independent of the A/L split.

k_path.cite: NIST Invar Fe-36Ni k(T) 4–300 K because ICES names an INVAR 36 heat-switch rod. ULTEM 1000 launch-lock legs have no NIST map — T0 hole.
